lines.en: I walk along the leaf veins.
My red shell has black spots.
I crawl to the leaf tip and turn back.
I'm tiny, and so are my steps.
I go around a dewdrop.

lines.zh: 叶尖太窄，我换到另一片。
lines.en: The leaf tip is too narrow, so I move to another.
My six legs move together, fast.
My wings are folded under the shell.
I climb down a grass stem.
I stop at the leaf's edge and look down.
I turn a corner along the leaf vein.
The wind comes; I grip the leaf.
I crawl into the sunny patch.

lines.zh: 我避开那片发黄的叶子。
lines.en: I avoid the yellowing leaf.
I slip down the stem.
I walk up the bark to higher ground.
I stop, my shell glossy.
The sun warms my red shell.
I count my own spots.
No one comes to this side of the leaf.
Only when the wind drops do I dare move.
I raise my antennae and probe.
Under my shell, I'm soft.
I rest a moment under the veins.
A bug passed nearby.
I shuffle a little toward the light.
That droplet will last me a while.
I wipe the dust off my antennae.
Your finger is bigger than a leaf.
Don't press down.
I'm small; look closely.
You're looking at my spots.
When I'm frightened, I fly off.
You're blocking my sun.
I look up and can't see all of you.

lines.zh: 你弯腰时，风先扑到我身上。
lines.en: When you bend down, the wind reaches me first.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你就不咬我了吧。
lines.en: I'll keep still, and you won't bite me, right?
I turn and climb under the leaf.
A crack in my shell.
My six legs curl in.
I fall to the soil, on my back.
I struggle to right myself.
One hit like that aches for a long time.
My wing is folded under the shell and won't move.
I crawl slowly.
I don't cry out. I can't.
I pull my head under the shell.
The crack in my shell widens a little more.
Is that the smell of honeydew?
The sweetness pulls my antennae forward.
I touch it with my antennae first.
That will last me a long while.
Hold still; I'll come to the edge.
I know that sweet smell.
When I'm full, I'll go.
Better than the sweat on your palm.
I can't carry it. I can only eat.

lines.zh: 再多一点，我就不怕你了。
lines.en: A little more and I won't fear you.
You touch me and I fly off at once.
I fall off the leaf.
I'm on my back, legs flailing.

lines.zh: 我从叶缘翻回来，腿发软。
lines.en: I flip back from the leaf edge, legs weak.

lines.zh: 你碰了叶子，我抓紧叶脉。
lines.en: You touched the leaf, and I grip the vein.
I tuck in my six legs.
I roll a little.
That frightened me badly.
I hide under the leaf vein.
Don't touch me again.

lines.zh: 另一只落在同一片叶上。
lines.en: Another has landed on the same leaf.
Our antennae touch.
It has two more spots than me.
We crawl to the leaf's underside together.
It walks slower than me.

lines.zh: 我们分开找各自的角落。
lines.en: We part to our own corners.
It flies off, lightly.
Its tiny tracks remain on the leaf.
Next time, on this same grass.
We both remember this spot.

lines.zh: 六只脚一起，才勉强拖住。
lines.en: All six legs barely manage to drag it.
This thing is wider than my shell.
I push twice. It won't move.
One grain of pollen lasts me half a day.
I hide it under the vein.
The pearl is too smooth to grip.
I nibble a bit and swallow slowly.
I drag it to the leaf stem.
I drag it half an inch and let go.
I carry it a few steps.
That huge shape is coming at me.
The shell opens and my wings move first.
First I retreat to the leaf's edge.
This side isn't safe.
I've gathered my legs.
When frightened, I fly.
This leaf won't protect me.
I'm heading into the wind.
You're far too big.
I have to leave this spot.
I've fixed on that bright patch.
My wings have partly opened.
Don't chase; I'm quick in the air.
I jump first, then fly.
I keep climbing higher.
I've gone under the leaf.
You can't see me now.
I stop to listen.
I'm keeping my distance.

lines.zh: 我从这一片跳到下一片。
lines.en: I hop from this leaf to the next.
A gust moves me elsewhere.
I hide on the shaded side of the stem.
I'm still watching your direction.
Don't reach out, or I take off at once.

lines.zh: 你的鞋尖离我越来越近。
lines.en: Your boot tip is getting closer and closer.
I'll find somewhere farther.
The grass hides it.
I back into the shadow of the leaf stalk.
I fly up and bump you once.
That's all the force I have, even at full tilt.
I kick with my legs.

lines.zh: 我这点分量，你大概没察觉。
lines.en: You probably didn't even feel my weight.
I gnaw your knuckle and get nowhere.
I bump you once and bounce right back.
This weight can't pin you.
I beat my wings desperately.

lines.zh: 我贴着你手背咬了一口。
lines.en: I land on your hand and nip it.

lines.zh: 撞完我晕头转向，落了地。
lines.en: After the bump I spin dizzily and drop.
I've landed on this leaf.
A red shell stands out.
First I fold my wings.
The leaf is still fresh.
The sun falls right here.
I come down slowly from above.
I land steady, my shell still bright red.
I'm the only one on this leaf.
I circle the leaf's center once.
I groom my antennae.

lines.zh: 火苗一点，我的壳就卷了。
lines.en: A spark touches me and my shell curls.

lines.zh: 我从叶上掉下去，摔晕了。
lines.en: I drop off the leaf and land dazed.
A dewdrop traps me.
The blast throws me into the grass.
A pebble grazes my shell.
A flash and I freeze.
The aphids are gone and my wings feel weak.
Thunder shakes me off the leaf.
I fall, and keep falling.
